_comment: Catalog of local models NOT bundled with ARIA Lite and not yet downloadable through it -- see backend/core/model_manager.py's install_model() docstring: this repo has no download/network layer yet. Each entry's downloadUrl is intentionally null; fill in a real source (e.g. a HuggingFace GGUF repo) before surfacing a real 'Get model' link in the UI. Surfaced read-only via backend/core/model_catalog.py in the webui Models page's 'Available' grid, gated by backend.core.pc_capability_tier so an entry above the current PC tier renders disabled with the actual reason.
